datasets.name: checks
queryLines:
SELECT checked_at, window_start AS day_judged,
  coalesce(nullif(episode, ''), 'none') AS episode, model_version AS model,
  upper(status) AS status, n_act, n_warn,
  replace(replace(replace(array_join(breaches, '; '), 'SITE_A', 'Site-A-GH'), 'SITE_B', 'Site-B-NS'), 'SITE_C', 'Site-C-VL') AS breaches
FROM drift_checks
ORDER BY checked_at DESC

datasets.name: check_summary
queryLines:
SELECT count(*) AS checks, count_if(status = 'act') AS act_checks,
  max_by(n_act, checked_at) AS latest_act, max_by(n_warn, checked_at) AS latest_warn
FROM drift_checks

datasets.name: latest_check
queryLines:
SELECT checked_at, window_start AS day_judged, model_version AS model,
  upper(status) AS status, n_act, n_warn,
  replace(replace(replace(array_join(breaches, '; '), 'SITE_A', 'Site-A-GH'), 'SITE_B', 'Site-B-NS'), 'SITE_C', 'Site-C-VL') AS breaches
FROM drift_checks

LIMIT 1

datasets.name: js_lines
queryLines:
WITH limits AS (
  -- the limits of heavden.monitoring.drift_check.THRESHOLDS
  SELECT * FROM VALUES
    ('feature_psi', 0.1, 0.25),
    ('prediction_js', 0.08, 0.12),
    ('alerts_per_nurse_shift', 2.5, 3.0),
    ('auprc_drop', 0.1, 0.2),
    ('brier_rise', 0.1, 0.2),
    ('quarantine_rate', 0.02, 0.05),
    ('missing_rate_change', 0.02, 0.05),
    ('monitor_difference', 0.01, NULL)
  AS limits(signal, warn_limit, act_limit)
),
judged AS (
  SELECT window_start AS day, model_version AS model, signal,
    CASE WHEN site_id = 'all' THEN 'All sites' WHEN site_id = 'SITE_A' THEN 'Site-A-GH' WHEN site_id = 'SITE_B' THEN 'Site-B-NS' WHEN site_id = 'SITE_C' THEN 'Site-C-VL' ELSE site_id END AS site, value
  FROM drift_metrics
  WHERE signal IN ('prediction_js') AND level <> 'shadow'
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY window_start, signal, coalesce(feature, ''), site_id
    ORDER BY checked_at DESC) = 1
)
SELECT day, model, site, site AS line, max(value) AS value
FROM judged 
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT day, model, site, 'Warn limit', l.warn_limit
FROM judged JOIN limits l ON l.signal = 'prediction_js' 
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT day, model, site, 'Act limit', l.act_limit
FROM judged JOIN limits l ON l.signal = 'prediction_js' 
WHERE l.act_limit IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: psi_latest
datasets.displayName: Input drift in the latest check, by feature and site
queryLines:
SELECT replace(feature, '_mean_1h', '') AS feature,
  max(CASE WHEN site_id = 'all' THEN value END) AS all_sites,
  max(CASE WHEN site_id = 'SITE_A' THEN value END) AS site_a,
  max(CASE WHEN site_id = 'SITE_B' THEN value END) AS site_b,
  max(CASE WHEN site_id = 'SITE_C' THEN value END) AS site_c,
  max(value) AS largest
FROM drift_metrics
WHERE signal = 'feature_psi'
  AND check_id = (SELECT check_id FROM drift_checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY feature
ORDER BY largest DESC

datasets.name: monitor_weekly
queryLines:
SELECT window.start AS week_start, CASE WHEN slice_value IS NULL THEN 'All sites' WHEN slice_value = 'SITE_A' THEN 'Site-A-GH' WHEN slice_value = 'SITE_B' THEN 'Site-B-NS' WHEN slice_value = 'SITE_C' THEN 'Site-C-VL' ELSE slice_value END AS site, count AS hours,
  auprc, brier, auroc
FROM inference_log_profile_metrics
WHERE column_name = ':table' AND log_type = 'INPUT' AND model_version = '*'
  AND (slice_key IS NULL OR slice_key = 'site_id')
  AND granularity = '1 week'

datasets.name: cross_check
datasets.displayName: Does the monitor agree with the check?
queryLines:
SELECT checked_at, window_start AS day_judged, feature AS compared,
  CASE WHEN site_id = 'all' THEN 'All sites' WHEN site_id = 'SITE_A' THEN 'Site-A-GH' WHEN site_id = 'SITE_B' THEN 'Site-B-NS' WHEN site_id = 'SITE_C' THEN 'Site-C-VL' ELSE site_id END AS site,
  reference AS check_number, observed AS monitor_number, value AS difference,
  CASE level WHEN 'stable' THEN 'agrees' ELSE 'DISAGREES' END AS verdict
FROM drift_metrics
WHERE signal = 'monitor_difference'
ORDER BY checked_at DESC

datasets.name: class_weekly
datasets.displayName: Classification metrics per hour, by week and site
queryLines:
WITH cells AS (
  SELECT window.start AS week_start, CASE WHEN slice_value IS NULL THEN 'All sites' WHEN slice_value = 'SITE_A' THEN 'Site-A-GH' WHEN slice_value = 'SITE_B' THEN 'Site-B-NS' WHEN slice_value = 'SITE_C' THEN 'Site-C-VL' ELSE slice_value END AS site,
    aggregate(filter(confusion_matrix, c -> c.label = '1' AND c.prediction = '1'), 0L, (n, c) -> n + c.count) AS tp, aggregate(filter(confusion_matrix, c -> c.label = '0' AND c.prediction = '1'), 0L, (n, c) -> n + c.count) AS fp,
    aggregate(filter(confusion_matrix, c -> c.label = '1' AND c.prediction = '0'), 0L, (n, c) -> n + c.count) AS fn, aggregate(filter(confusion_matrix, c -> c.label = '0' AND c.prediction = '0'), 0L, (n, c) -> n + c.count) AS tn
  FROM inference_log_profile_metrics
  WHERE column_name = ':table' AND log_type = 'INPUT' AND model_version = '*'
    AND (slice_key IS NULL OR slice_key = 'site_id')
    AND granularity = '1 week'
), rates AS (
  SELECT *, tp + fn AS escalation_hours, tn + fp AS quiet_hours, tp + fp + fn + tn AS known,
    tp / nullif(tp + fp, 0) AS precision_esc, tp / nullif(tp + fn, 0) AS recall_esc,
    tn / nullif(tn + fn, 0) AS precision_quiet, tn / nullif(tn + fp, 0) AS recall_quiet
  FROM cells
), f1 AS (
  SELECT *,
    2 * precision_esc * recall_esc / nullif(precision_esc + recall_esc, 0) AS f1_esc,
    2 * precision_quiet * recall_quiet / nullif(precision_quiet + recall_quiet, 0)
      AS f1_quiet
  FROM rates
), metrics AS (
  SELECT week_start, site, known AS labelled_hours, escalation_hours,
    precision_esc, recall_esc, f1_esc,
    (precision_esc + precision_quiet) / 2 AS precision_macro,
    (recall_esc + recall_quiet) / 2 AS recall_macro,
    (f1_esc + f1_quiet) / 2 AS f1_macro,
    (precision_esc * escalation_hours + precision_quiet * quiet_hours) / known
      AS precision_weighted,
    (recall_esc * escalation_hours + recall_quiet * quiet_hours) / known AS recall_weighted,
    (f1_esc * escalation_hours + f1_quiet * quiet_hours) / known AS f1_weighted,
    (tp + tn) / known AS accuracy, quiet_hours / known AS never_alert_accuracy,
    fp / nullif(fp + tn, 0) AS false_positive_rate, recall_quiet AS specificity,
    tp, fn, fp, tn
  FROM f1 WHERE known > 0
)
SELECT * FROM metrics

), rates AS (
  SELECT *, tp + fn AS escalation_hours, tn + fp AS quiet_hours, tp + fp + fn + tn AS known,
    tp / nullif(tp + fp, 0) AS precision_esc, tp / nullif(tp + fn, 0) AS recall_esc,
    tn / nullif(tn + fn, 0) AS precision_quiet, tn / nullif(tn + fp, 0) AS recall_quiet
  FROM cells
), f1 AS (
  SELECT *,
    2 * precision_esc * recall_esc / nullif(precision_esc + recall_esc, 0) AS f1_esc,
    2 * precision_quiet * recall_quiet / nullif(precision_quiet + recall_quiet, 0)
      AS f1_quiet
  FROM rates
), metrics AS (
  SELECT week_start, site, known AS labelled_hours, escalation_hours,
    precision_esc, recall_esc, f1_esc,
    (precision_esc + precision_quiet) / 2 AS precision_macro,
    (recall_esc + recall_quiet) / 2 AS recall_macro,
    (f1_esc + f1_quiet) / 2 AS f1_macro,
    (precision_esc * escalation_hours + precision_quiet * quiet_hours) / known
      AS precision_weighted,
    (recall_esc * escalation_hours + recall_quiet * quiet_hours) / known AS recall_weighted,
    (f1_esc * escalation_hours + f1_quiet * quiet_hours) / known AS f1_weighted,
    (tp + tn) / known AS accuracy, quiet_hours / known AS never_alert_accuracy,
    fp / nullif(fp + tn, 0) AS false_positive_rate, recall_quiet AS specificity,
    tp, fn, fp, tn
  FROM f1 WHERE known > 0
)
SELECT week_start, 'Accuracy of the model' AS line, accuracy AS value
FROM metrics WHERE site = 'All sites'
UNION ALL
SELECT week_start, 'Accuracy of a model that never alerts', never_alert_accuracy
FROM metrics WHERE site = 'All sites'

datasets.name: cost
queryLines:
SELECT u.usage_date AS day,
  CASE WHEN u.billing_origin_product = 'DATA_QUALITY_MONITORING' THEN 'monitor refresh'
       WHEN u.billing_origin_product = 'DLT' THEN 'pipeline'
       ELSE coalesce(u.custom_tags['component'], lower(u.billing_origin_product)) END
    AS part,
  u.usage_metadata.job_run_id AS job_run_id,
  u.usage_quantity * p.pricing.effective_list.default AS usd
FROM system.billing.usage u
JOIN system.billing.list_prices p
  ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.cloud = p.cloud AND u.usage_unit = p.usage_unit
 AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time
 AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time)
WHERE u.identity_metadata.run_as = current_user()
  AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 90)

WITH own AS (

       ELSE coalesce(u.custom_tags['component'], lower(u.billing_origin_product)) END
    AS part,
  u.usage_metadata.job_run_id AS job_run_id,
  u.usage_quantity * p.pricing.effective_list.default AS usd

JOIN system.billing.list_prices p
  ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.cloud = p.cloud AND u.usage_unit = p.usage_unit
 AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time
 AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time)
WHERE u.identity_metadata.run_as = current_user()
), shared AS (
SELECT u.usage_date AS day,
  CASE WHEN u.billing_origin_product = 'DATA_QUALITY_MONITORING' THEN 'monitor refresh'
       WHEN u.billing_origin_product = 'DLT' THEN 'pipeline'
       ELSE coalesce(u.custom_tags['component'], lower(u.billing_origin_product)) END
    AS part,
  u.usage_metadata.job_run_id AS job_run_id,
  u.usage_quantity * p.pricing.effective_list.default AS usd
FROM system.billing.usage u
JOIN system.billing.list_prices p
  ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.cloud = p.cloud AND u.usage_unit = p.usage_unit
 AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time
 AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time)
WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND u.custom_tags['project'] = 'heavden'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT round(sum(usd), 2) FROM own WHERE day >= date_sub(current_date(), 7))
    AS last_7_days,
  (SELECT round(sum(usd), 2) FROM own WHERE day >= date_trunc('MONTH', current_date()))
    AS this_month,
  (SELECT round(sum(usd), 2) FROM own WHERE part = 'monitor refresh'
     AND day >= date_trunc('MONTH', current_date())) AS monitor_this_month,
  (SELECT round(sum(usd), 2) FROM shared
     WHERE day >= date_trunc('MONTH', current_date())) AS shared_this_month

# Model & Drift

Synthetic data. Every patient and hospital is invented. Not a medical device. After each load of new data the drift check compares the latest day with the data the model in use was built on. **Warn** asks for a look; **act** opens a retrain request that a person approves or rejects. Signals, limits and decisions: Drift Incident Runbook.

Sites: **Site-A-GH** HeavDen General Hospital; **Site-B-NS** HeavDen Northshore Medical Center; **Site-C-VL** HeavDen Valley Community Hospital.

lines:
## The textbook metrics, for context and learning

Not used to decide anything: the model is judged on AUPRC, Brier, AUROC and alerts per nurse per shift. Here each **patient-hour** counts once: *predicted* = the hour was in the High band (the alert threshold), *actual* = an escalation followed within 6 hours. Only about 1 hour in 100 is followed by one, so **accuracy and the weighted averages are dominated by the quiet hours**: a model that never alerts scores about 99% accuracy while catching no one (below). **Macro** averages weigh both classes equally; the **escalation class** shows what matters: recall = share of escalation hours flagged, precision = share of High hours followed by an escalation. Counted per hour, not per alert, over hours whose outcome is known.

Sites: **Site-A-GH** HeavDen General Hospital; **Site-B-NS** HeavDen Northshore Medical Center; **Site-C-VL** HeavDen Valley Community Hospital.
